lled.title: Leave ledger
lled.description: Every leave entry of an employee with its reason, source and running balance. Entries are never edited: a correction is a reversal. HR can post an opening balance, a grant or an adjustment, and check the balances against the leave policies.
lled.denied: You may not read leave ledgers
lled.denied.body: Ask your administrator for permission to read the leave ledger.
lled.loadError: The leave ledger could not be loaded.
lled.employee.help: Type an employee number. You see only the people your access covers.
lled.pick.body: Pick a company and an employee number to see the leave ledger.
lled.never: Entries are never changed or deleted. To correct one, reverse it with a reason and post the right entry.
lled.empty.body: Employee {employee} has no leave entries for this selection.
lled.mismatch.title: The numbers do not agree
lled.mismatch.body: The entries shown add up to {screen}, but the server reports a balance of {server}. Do not rely on either number: report this to support.
lled.noPolicy: No leave policy applies to this leave type.
lled.entries.none: No entries in this leave year.
lled.entries.filtered: No entries match the filters. The running balance still counts every earlier entry.
lled.entries.caption: Ledger entries of {name}
lled.reverse.title: Reverse this entry
lled.reverse.body: A new entry of the opposite quantity is posted against the {type} entry of {date}.
lled.reverse.never: The original entry stays in the ledger. Only an entry that is not already reversed, and not a reversal itself, can be reversed.
lled.reverse.date.help: Left empty, the reversal takes the date of the entry. It must be in the same leave year.
lled.post.title: Post an opening balance, grant or adjustment
lled.post.body: The entry is dated, needs a reason, and can only be corrected later by a reversal. A positive quantity adds leave, a negative one takes it away.
lled.post.settles: This adjustment settles the period {period} listed by the balance check, so the check no longer lists it.
lled.post.quantity.help: With a minus sign to take leave away, at most four decimal places.
lled.post.quantity.invalid: Give a number other than zero, at most 9999, with at most four decimal places.
lled.post.expires.help: Only for leave that must be used by a date.
lled.recompute.title: Check the balances
lled.recompute.body: The system works the balances out again from the leave policies and compares them with the ledger. It lists each difference with its cause.
lled.recompute.unchanged.body: The check only reports. HR decides and posts an adjustment where one is needed; nothing is posted by itself.
lled.recompute.clean.body: {count} items were checked up to {date} and the ledger matches the leave policies.
lled.recompute.caption: Differences between the ledger and the leave policies
lled.recompute.noSuggestion: Nothing to post here: review the entries.
